essence: The third beyond being and non-being: leap the two-yoked course; freedom contagious among the unfree — Thy hangers-on live free (vv01-02, v18).
Love's instruments: remembrance-medicine, begged moon-glance, heart-union vessel, flooding meditation, Śiva-din that routs pain — arrival roared and danced (vv03-11, v13).
Supremacy without second: moon-crowned high Lord, cancelled yogas, play-lake ocean, shamed miseries, beads told inside oneness, knower in known — closing keen and swoon (vv04, v12, vv14-17, vv19-21).

sections.SUMMARY: It is affection's logic: leap over being and non-being to the third (1); find freedom contagious among the unfree (2); take remembrance as medicine (3); crown Him moon-umbrella king (4); beg one glance (5); interrogate one's own dryness (6); mark unmelted hearts contemptible (7); make heart-union the vessel of powers (8); let meditation flood joys and sorrows alike (9); never part, more than self (10); roar and dance arrival (11); cancel other knowables and yogas (12); let Śiva-sound chase sorrows (13); deny any second great person (14); shrink the ocean to a play-lake by servitude (15); shame miseries by manifestation (16); recite inside supremacy (17); tie the knot of being-non-being (18); face the unseen all-pervading brightness (19); find the knower inside the known (20); and close crying sharp in knowing bewilderment (21).

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of affection (praṇaya); the vyabhicāri is wonder (camatkāra) at the third beyond being/non-being. Abhinava's rasa theory frames this as śṛṅgāra: the relish (camatkāra) of the Absolute as beloved.
